earn_rate_points_per_dollar.quote: You earn 3 points for every $1 spent on eligible purchases.

point_value_cents.quote: Points are worth 1 cent each when redeemed for a statement credit.

reversal_rule.quote: When a purchase is refunded, in full or in part, including any price adjustment, points earned on the refunded amount are deducted from your balance in proportion to the amount refunded.

extends_months.quote: Extended Warranty Protection extends the original manufacturer's warranty by 1 additional year on eligible items with an original manufacturer's warranty of 3 years or less.

max_original_warranty_months.quote: Extended Warranty Protection extends the original manufacturer's warranty by 1 additional year on eligible items with an original manufacturer's warranty of 3 years or less.

window_days.quote: Claims must be filed within 60 days of the product failure.
